items.t1_ex: The module failed again after the final channel test.

items.t5_ex: The board passed visual inspection after careful cleaning.
items.t6_ex: The card was swapped to isolate the failure.
items.t7_ex: The fuse was blown, so we installed a new one.

items.t20_ex: The missing component was replaced before final verification.

items.t23_ex: The signal line was restored after trace repair.
items.t24_ex: The LED indicator stayed red after the system reset.
items.t25_ex: The PhotoMOS output matched the reference board measurement.
